services.desc: Winter on Resurrection Bay! Rates Person (All Ages): $189 One Boat Private Charter (Up to 6 Passengers): $1,134 Please Note: Price does not include tax and Seward passenger fees. Duration 3.5 Hours About Contrary to what people might lead you to believe, Seward, Alaska, and the ocean don’t shut down just because it’s winter! Yes, the weather may be colder, but Resurrection Bay and beyond are positively scenic in the winter months. Our boats are equipped with a cabin heater to keep you comfortable on board, and we have hot drinks for our guests. services.desc: Our Most Popular Trip! Rates Person (All Ages): $189 One Boat Private Charter (Up to 6 Passengers): $1,134 Please Note: Price does not include tax and Seward passenger fees. Duration 3.5 Hours About Our most popular tour, the Kenai Fjords and Resurrection Bay Half Day Tour, will bring you to the best of Resurrection Bay and beyond, including being in Kenai Fjords National Park. Resurrection Bay tends to be calm, and has some of the most scenic vistas and best wildlife watching around. services.name: 7 Hour Tour Deeper into Kenai Fjords National Park / Aialik Bay
services.desc: Added Time Means More Wildlife Sighting Opportunities Rates Person (All Ages): $309 One Boat Private Charter (Up to 6 Passengers): $1,854 Please Note: Price does not include tax and Seward passenger fees. Duration 6 Hours About On pretty much every trip (including half days) we check out Bear Glacier, on the eastern side of Kenai Fjords National Park in Resurrection Bay. On longer trips we go deeper into Kenai Fjords National Park and the tidewater glaciers of Aialik Bay (Holgate and/or Aialik Glaciers).
